news.titleEn: S&P 500 Closes at a Record After Soft Producer Prices, Breaks Above 7,800
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 climbed to a fresh intraday record above 7,800 and closed near 7,799 on August 13, as cooler-than-expected producer price data and falling oil prices reinforced bets the Fed will hold off on raising rates.
news.conclusionZh: 标普500指数8月13日创下逾7800点历史新高，通胀数据降温提振市场。
news.whyEn: The milestone reflects broad investor confidence that inflation is cooling without derailing growth, directly shaping borrowing costs, retirement savings and corporate valuations across the economy.
news.whyZh: 该里程碑反映投资者对通胀降温而经济不失速的信心，直接影响借贷成本、养老金及企业估值。
news.detailEn: Wall Street pushed the S&P 500 to an intraday record high of 7,808.42 on August 13, with the index closing at 7,798.99, up 0.65%. The Nasdaq Composite gained 0.81% to 26,803.03 on strength in Meta, Micron and Netflix, while the Dow edged up 0.13% to 53,839.99. The rally was fueled by a tamer-than-forecast producer price inflation reading and a more than 2% drop in Brent and WTI crude, both of which reinforced trader bets that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising rates at its September meeting. Semiconductor and other heavyweight technology stocks led the gains. Following the report, both Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs raised their year-end S&P 500 price targets to 8,000, underscoring growing Wall Street optimism even as some strategists warn valuations are historically stretched.
news.detailZh: 华尔街8月13日推动标普500指数盘中创下7808.42点的历史新高，收盘报7798.99点，上涨0.65%。纳斯达克综合指数受Meta、美光和Netflix走强带动上涨0.81%，报26803.03点；道琼斯工业平均指数小幅上涨0.13%，报53839.99点。此轮上涨的推动力来自低于预期的生产者价格通胀数据，以及布伦特原油和WTI原油双双下跌逾2%，两者均强化了交易员对美联储9月会议将暂缓加息的预期。芯片股及其他权重科技股领涨大盘。数据公布后，摩根士丹利和高盛均将标普500指数年终目标上调至8000点，显示华尔街乐观情绪升温，尽管部分策略师警告当前估值处于历史高位。

news.titleEn: Workday Shares Surge After Report Silver Lake Is in Talks to Buy Company at $43 Billion Valuation
news.conclusionEn: Workday shares jumped nearly 25% and trading was briefly halted after Reuters reported private equity firm Silver Lake is in talks to take the HR and finance software maker private at roughly a $43 billion valuation.
news.conclusionZh: 传私募巨头Silver Lake拟以约430亿美元估值将Workday私有化，股价暴涨近25%。
news.whyEn: A deal of this size would rank among the largest software buyouts in history and signal private equity's growing willingness to bet on legacy enterprise software firms struggling to prove their relevance in the AI era.
news.whyZh: 若交易达成将成史上最大软件收购案之一，反映私募股权对传统企业软件公司AI转型前景的押注。
news.detailEn: Workday shares posted their best single-day gain in a decade after Reuters reported that private equity giant Silver Lake is in talks to acquire the human-resources and financial management software company, which carries a market value of about $43 billion. The discussions have been ongoing for months and there is no guarantee a deal will be finalized; Silver Lake could bring in additional investors to help finance what would be one of its largest technology bets to date. Before the report, Workday shares had fallen roughly 15% this year and were down more than 40% from their 2024 peak, as investors questioned whether traditional enterprise software vendors can keep pace with AI-native competitors. Silver Lake previously teamed up with Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and Affinity Partners on its roughly $55 billion take-private deal for Electronic Arts last year, suggesting a similar consortium structure could emerge for Workday.
news.detailZh: 路透社报道称，私募股权巨头Silver Lake正洽谈收购人力资源与财务管理软件公司Workday（市值约430亿美元）并将其私有化，消息传出后Workday股价创下十年来最大单日涨幅。相关磋商已持续数月，交易能否最终落地尚无定论；Silver Lake可能引入其他投资者共同出资，这将是其迄今最大规模的科技投资之一。在此消息之前，Workday股价今年已下跌约15%，较2024年高点回落超过40%，投资者担忧传统企业软件厂商能否跟上AI原生竞争对手的步伐。Silver Lake去年曾联合沙特公共投资基金及Affinity Partners，以约550亿美元收购电子游戏巨头艺电（EA）并将其私有化，类似的财团结构可能也会出现在Workday这笔交易中。

news.titleEn: Former Syrian President Assad Sentenced to Death in Absentia
news.conclusionEn: A Damascus court sentenced former Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, his brother Maher and his cousin Atef Najib to death in absentia for premeditated murder, torture and crimes against humanity committed during the 14-year civil war.
news.conclusionZh: 叙利亚法院缺席判处前总统阿萨德及其兄弟、表亲死刑，罪名为反人类罪。
news.whyEn: The verdict marks the first legal reckoning against Assad or his inner circle since his regime's fall 20 months ago, testing Syria's transitional justice process and its request for Russia to extradite the family.
news.whyZh: 这是阿萨德政权垮台20个月以来针对其核心圈子的首次法律追责，考验叙利亚过渡司法与对俄引渡请求。
news.detailEn: The Fourth Criminal Court in Damascus found Bashar al-Assad, who was toppled in December 2024 and now lives in exile in Russia, guilty of premeditated murder, torture and crimes against humanity, sentencing him to death in absentia. His brother Maher al-Assad and several former regime officials were also sentenced to death after being convicted of war crimes, extrajudicial killings, and the detention and torture of children during Syria's 14-year conflict, which left about half a million people dead. Also condemned was Assad's maternal cousin Atef Najib, convicted of overseeing the 2011 crackdown in Daraa province that sparked the uprising leading to civil war. The ruling is the first legal action against Assad or his inner circle since the family's five-decade rule ended 20 months ago; Assad and Maher fled to Russia and received political asylum, and Syria's new government has formally asked Moscow to hand them over, though Russia has given no indication it will comply.
news.detailZh: 大马士革第四刑事法院裁定，2024年12月被推翻、现流亡俄罗斯的前总统巴沙尔·阿萨德犯有蓄意谋杀、酷刑及反人类罪，缺席判处其死刑。其兄弟马希尔·阿萨德及多名前政权官员也因在叙利亚长达14年、造成约50万人死亡的内战中犯下战争罪、法外处决及拘押虐待儿童等罪行被判处死刑。阿萨德的表亲阿泰夫·纳吉卜同样被判死刑，其被控主导了2011年代尔祖尔省的镇压行动，该行动引发了后来演变为内战的起义。这是阿萨德家族长达五十年统治于20个月前终结以来，针对阿萨德本人及其核心圈子的首次法律行动；阿萨德与马希尔逃往俄罗斯并获得政治庇护，叙利亚新政府已正式要求莫斯科将二人引渡，但俄方尚未表态是否配合。

news.titleEn: Turkey's Parliament Approves a Pardon-Like Bill for Thousands of PKK Militants
news.conclusionEn: Turkey's parliament voted 468-88 to approve conditional pardon legislation for thousands of Kurdish PKK militants, to take effect once authorities verify the group has fully disarmed, advancing a peace process aimed at ending a decades-long conflict.
news.conclusionZh: 土耳其议会以468票赞成通过对库尔德工人党武装人员的有条件赦免法案。
news.whyEn: The bill is a major step toward ending a conflict that has killed tens of thousands of people over four decades, with implications for regional stability and closer Turkish-Iraqi relations.
news.whyZh: 该法案是结束长达四十年、造成数万人死亡的冲突的重要一步，将影响地区稳定及土伊关系。
news.detailEn: Turkey's parliament approved legislation introducing a conditional pardon for thousands of Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) militants, with lawmakers voting 468 to 88 in favor. The pardon will only take effect after Turkish authorities verify the PKK has fully disarmed. The move follows the PKK's announcement last year that it would end its decades-long armed campaign against the Turkish state and dissolve itself, responding to a call from its imprisoned founder Abdullah Ocalan, and a symbolic disarmament ceremony held in northern Iraq. However, the PKK has voiced reservations about the new law, calling it a "beginning" with "serious shortcomings and deficiencies," and is pressing for Ocalan's release from prison, saying the peace process can only move forward if he can "live and work freely." The conflict has killed tens of thousands since the 1980s, and a durable resolution could also pave the way for closer ties between Turkey and Iraq.
news.detailZh: 土耳其议会通过了一项针对库尔德工人党（PKK）数千名武装人员的有条件赦免立法，以468票赞成、88票反对获得通过。该赦免将在土耳其当局核实PKK已完全解除武装后方能生效。此举延续了PKK去年响应其被监禁的创始人厄贾兰的号召，宣布结束数十年对土耳其国家的武装斗争并自行解散、并在伊拉克北部举行象征性解除武装仪式的进程。不过，PKK对新法案表达了保留态度，称其只是「一个开始」，仍存在「严重的不足与缺陷」，并要求释放厄贾兰，称唯有厄贾兰能够「自由生活与工作」，和平进程才能真正推进。该冲突自20世纪80年代以来已造成数万人死亡，若能持久解决，也可能为土耳其与伊拉克关系的进一步缓和铺平道路。

news.titleEn: CoreWeave Stock Pops 14% as Revenue Doubles on Accelerating AI Infrastructure Demand
news.conclusionEn: AI cloud provider CoreWeave reported second-quarter revenue of $2.58 billion, more than double a year earlier, with its revenue backlog reaching $104 billion, sending shares up as much as 14%.
news.conclusionZh: AI云服务商CoreWeave二季度营收翻倍至25.8亿美元，积压订单达1040亿美元，股价大涨。
news.whyEn: The results are a key barometer of whether real-world demand for AI computing power can keep justifying the massive capital spending pouring into data centers and chips.
news.whyZh: 该业绩是检验AI算力真实需求能否支撑数据中心与芯片巨额资本支出的重要风向标。
news.detailEn: CoreWeave, one of the largest specialized providers of AI cloud computing capacity, reported second-quarter revenue of approximately $2.58 billion, up 112% from $1.21 billion a year earlier and slightly ahead of Wall Street expectations, as demand for AI computing infrastructure continued to climb. Shares jumped as much as 13-14% in extended trading following the report. The company's revenue backlog swelled to $104 billion, a figure that excludes more than $25 billion in new commitments signed since the quarter closed, underscoring the depth of contracted future demand. CoreWeave posted a loss of $1.14 per share for the quarter as it continues to invest heavily in data center buildout, and it guided for $12.4 billion to $13.2 billion in full-year 2026 revenue with adjusted operating income of $960 million to $1.15 billion. The results add to a string of strong AI infrastructure earnings this earnings season that have helped fuel the broader stock market rally.
news.detailZh: 作为最大的AI云算力专业服务商之一，CoreWeave公布第二季度营收约25.8亿美元，较去年同期的12.1亿美元增长112%，略超华尔街预期，反映AI算力基础设施需求持续攀升。财报公布后，其股价在盘后交易中一度大涨13%至14%。公司的营收积压订单膨胀至1040亿美元，该数字尚未计入本季度结束后新签署的超250亿美元合约，凸显未来已签约需求的深度。由于持续大举投资数据中心建设，CoreWeave本季度每股亏损1.14美元，并将2026全年营收指引定为124亿至132亿美元，调整后营业利润为9.6亿至11.5亿美元。该业绩延续了本财报季AI基础设施企业强劲表现的势头，助推了更广泛的股市上涨行情。

news.titleEn: Super Micro Forecasts Fiscal 2027 Revenue Up to $72 Billion, Above Wall Street Estimates
news.conclusionEn: Server maker Super Micro Computer forecast fiscal 2027 revenue of $65 billion to $72 billion, well above analyst estimates of about $52.5 billion, betting that AI server demand will keep fueling growth after Q4 gross margins nearly doubled.
news.conclusionZh: 超微电脑（Super Micro）预测2027财年营收最高720亿美元，远超市场预期。
news.whyEn: The upbeat guidance, alongside a sharp margin recovery, signals that demand for AI-optimized servers remains robust even as investors scrutinize whether AI infrastructure spending is sustainable.
news.whyZh: 乐观指引与利润率大幅回升表明AI服务器需求依然强劲，为AI基建支出可持续性提供正面信号。
news.detailEn: Super Micro Computer forecast fiscal 2027 revenue between $65 billion and $72 billion, comfortably above the roughly $52.5 billion analysts had expected, according to data compiled by LSEG, as the AI server maker bets that strong demand for its AI-optimized hardware will drive another year of rapid growth. The guidance follows fiscal fourth-quarter results in which net sales came in at $11.1 billion with gross margin of 17.5%, nearly double the 9.5% margin from a year earlier and well above prior guidance, driven by a more favorable customer and product mix. Full fiscal-year 2026 revenue reached $39.1 billion, up from $22.0 billion in fiscal 2025, with the company disclosing more than $60 billion in new orders received during the fourth quarter alone. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Super Micro guided for revenue of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion, versus consensus estimates of roughly $11.68 billion, sending shares higher as investors welcomed evidence that AI infrastructure demand remains far from saturated.
news.detailZh: 超微电脑（Super Micro）预测其2027财年营收将在650亿至720亿美元之间，明显高于LSEG汇总的分析师约525亿美元的预期，这家AI服务器制造商押注其AI优化硬件的强劲需求将带动新一年的快速增长。该指引发布前，公司公布的第四财季业绩显示净销售额为111亿美元，毛利率达17.5%，几乎是去年同期9.5%的两倍，也远超此前指引，主要得益于更有利的客户与产品结构。2026整个财年营收达391亿美元，高于2025财年的220亿美元，公司披露仅第四季度新增订单就超过600亿美元。展望2027财年第一季度，超微电脑给出的营收指引为145亿至155亿美元，高于市场普遍预期的约116.8亿美元，消息公布后股价上涨，投资者对AI基础设施需求远未见顶的迹象表示欢迎。

news.titleEn: GM Reaches Up to $4.5 Billion Parts Deal Designed to Avoid Supply Chain Troubles
news.conclusionEn: General Motors set up a financing arrangement worth up to $4.5 billion to guarantee supplies of critical auto parts, using a bank syndicate led by JPMorgan Chase and Banco Santander to prepay suppliers and safeguard against future disruptions.
news.conclusionZh: 通用汽车设立最高45亿美元的零部件保供融资安排，防范供应链中断风险。
news.whyEn: The unusual off-balance-sheet financing structure reflects how automakers are still reshaping supply chains years after pandemic-era shortages, aiming to protect production from weather events, disasters and cyberattacks.
news.whyZh: 这一另类表外融资结构反映车企仍在重塑供应链，以防范天气、灾害及网络攻击导致的生产中断。
news.detailEn: General Motors has set up a plan to guarantee the supply of up to $4.5 billion in critical auto parts, aiming to protect the company against supply shocks caused by extreme weather, natural disasters or cyberattacks. Under the arrangement, a newly formed entity called Procura Auto Parts LLC will buy parts inventory from key suppliers and front the cash, funded by a bank syndicate led by JPMorgan Chase and Banco Santander. GM will pay Procura interest and fees upfront and pay for the parts only when it actually needs them, with suppliers storing the inventory in the meantime; GM will settle its obligations after consuming the inventory, with a final deadline of August 2029. The facility lets GM secure greater parts availability while delaying cash outlays until parts are used in production, a response to a string of supply disruptions in recent years that have periodically shut down assembly lines across the industry.
news.detailZh: 通用汽车设立了一项最高达45亿美元的计划，用于保障关键汽车零部件的供应，旨在防范极端天气、自然灾害或网络攻击造成的供应冲击。根据该安排，一家新成立的实体Procura Auto Parts LLC将从主要供应商处购买零部件库存并垫付现金，资金来自摩根大通与桑坦德银行牵头的银团。通用汽车将预先向Procura支付利息与费用，仅在实际需要时才为零部件付款，期间由供应商负责库存保管；通用汽车将在消耗库存后结清相关款项，最终截止日期为2029年8月。该融资安排使通用汽车能够在延迟现金支出、直至零部件投入生产使用时才付款的同时，确保更充足的零部件供应，这也是对近年来一系列曾数次导致行业内多条装配线停工的供应链中断事件的应对。

news.titleEn: Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner Buy Los Angeles Lakers at a Record $12.5 Billion Valuation
news.conclusionEn: Former Disney CEO Bob Iger and Thrive Capital founder Josh Kushner are buying the Los Angeles Lakers from Mark Walter for $12.5 billion, the highest price ever paid for a U.S. sports franchise.
news.conclusionZh: 前迪士尼CEO伊格尔与Thrive Capital创始人库什纳以125亿美元创纪录价格收购湖人队。
news.whyEn: The record valuation, up 25% from the Lakers' sale just 14 months earlier, underscores surging investor appetite for marquee sports franchises as an asset class with rapidly appreciating media and brand value.
news.whyZh: 该估值较14个月前的收购价上涨25%，凸显投资者对顶级体育资产日益增长的兴趣。
news.detailEn: Bob Iger, who stepped down as Disney CEO in March and had previously served as a venture partner at Thrive Capital, is teaming up with Thrive founder and Miami Heat minority owner Josh Kushner to buy the Los Angeles Lakers at a $12.5 billion valuation, a record price for a US sports franchise. The deal comes just 14 months after the Buss family sold a controlling stake in the team to billionaire Mark Walter at a $10 billion valuation, meaning Walter stands to pocket a roughly $2.5 billion profit in just over a year. Kushner, 41, is the younger brother of White House adviser Jared Kushner and co-founder of Oscar Health. The transaction is subject to Thrive's ongoing due diligence and approval from the NBA's Board of Governors before it can close, a process that typically takes several months for deals of this size.
news.detailZh: 今年3月卸任迪士尼CEO、此前曾担任Thrive Capital风险合伙人的鲍勃·伊格尔，正与Thrive创始人、迈阿密热火队少数股东乔什·库什纳联手，以125亿美元估值收购洛杉矶湖人队，创下美国体育特许经营权的最高成交价纪录。该交易距巴斯家族以100亿美元估值将球队控股权出售给亿万富翁马克·沃尔特仅过去14个月，这意味着沃尔特在短短一年多时间里就将获利约25亿美元。现年41岁的库什纳是白宫顾问贾里德·库什纳的弟弟，也是Oscar Health的联合创始人。该交易尚需经过Thrive的尽职调查，并获得NBA理事会批准方可完成，此类规模的交易审批通常需要数月时间。

news.titleEn: Home Depot CEO Ted Decker Taking Temporary Medical Leave
news.conclusionEn: Home Depot said chair, president and CEO Ted Decker is taking a temporary medical leave of absence expected to last several months, with two senior executives sharing oversight of daily operations in his absence.
news.conclusionZh: 家得宝CEO泰德·德克尔因病暂时休假，两位高管将分管日常运营。
news.whyEn: Sudden leadership transitions at a major retailer create near-term uncertainty for investors and employees, even though Home Depot has moved quickly to install experienced interim leadership.
news.whyZh: 大型零售商高层突然变动为投资者与员工带来短期不确定性，尽管公司已迅速安排资深过渡管理层。
news.detailEn: Home Depot announced that Chair, President and CEO Ted Decker will take a temporary medical leave of absence expected to last for several months, without disclosing further details about his condition. The board, acting on Decker's recommendation, named two long-serving executives to jointly oversee the office of the CEO during his absence: Senior Executive Vice President Ann-Marie Campbell will oversee day-to-day operations, while Executive Vice President and CFO Richard McPhail will oversee financial management and the company's Pro-focused subsidiaries. Independent lead director Greg Brenneman will chair the board during Decker's leave. The retailer emphasized continuity of its strategy and leadership bench, seeking to reassure investors that operations will proceed smoothly even as the world's largest home-improvement chain navigates the temporary transition.
news.detailZh: 家得宝宣布，董事长、总裁兼首席执行官泰德·德克尔将休一段预计持续数月的临时病假，公司未披露其病情细节。董事会依据德克尔本人的建议，任命两位资深高管在其休假期间共同负责首席执行官办公室的运作：高级执行副总裁安-玛丽·坎贝尔将负责日常运营监督，执行副总裁兼首席财务官理查德·麦克费尔将负责财务管理及公司专业客户（Pro）相关子公司的监督。独立首席董事格雷格·布伦曼将在德克尔休假期间主持董事会工作。这家全球最大家居装修零售商强调其战略与管理梯队的连续性，力图向投资者保证在此临时过渡期间公司运营将平稳推进。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing time, money or effort into a decision because of what has already been spent, rather than evaluating the choice based on future costs and benefits alone. Money or time already spent is gone regardless of what you decide next, so rational decision-making should ignore it entirely and focus only on whether continuing is still the best use of resources going forward. Managers and founders who fall into this trap often keep funding failing projects simply because walking away would mean admitting the prior investment was wasted.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指人们倾向于因为已经投入的时间、金钱或精力而继续投入某项决策，而不是仅根据未来的成本与收益来评估选择。已经花掉的钱或时间无论接下来怎么决定都无法收回，因此理性决策应该完全忽略它，只关注继续投入是否仍是资源的最佳配置。陷入这一陷阱的管理者或创业者，常常仅仅因为放弃就意味着承认此前的投入是白费，而继续为注定失败的项目输血。
businessTips.exampleEn: A startup has spent $200,000 building a product feature that user testing shows nobody wants; the sunk cost fallacy would push the founder to keep funding it to "justify" the spend, while the rational move is to redirect the remaining budget toward features customers actually value.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家初创公司已投入20万美元开发一项用户测试证明无人需要的功能；沉没成本谬误会驱使创始人为「不浪费之前的投入」而继续投钱，但理性做法应是将剩余预算转向客户真正看重的功能。

businessTips.explanationEn: Churn rate measures the percentage of customers or subscribers who stop doing business with a company over a given period, and it is one of the most important health metrics for any subscription-based side hustle or startup. High churn quietly undermines growth because a business can spend heavily on acquiring new customers while losing existing ones just as fast, leaving revenue flat or declining despite apparent sales activity. Tracking churn monthly, and understanding why customers leave, lets a founder fix retention problems before they cap the business's growth ceiling.
businessTips.explanationZh: 流失率衡量在一定时期内停止与公司继续往来的客户或订阅用户所占的比例，是任何订阅制副业或初创企业最重要的健康指标之一。高流失率会悄悄侵蚀增长，因为企业可能一边大举投入获客，一边以同样速度流失现有客户，导致营收即便表面上销售活跃，实际却停滞甚至下滑。按月追踪流失率并理解客户离开的原因，能让创业者在留存问题限制企业增长上限之前及时修正。
businessTips.exampleEn: A creator running a $10/month newsletter subscription gains 100 new subscribers each month but loses 90 to churn; despite the busy sign-up activity, net growth is nearly flat, signaling the real priority should be improving content value and retention, not just marketing spend.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位创作者经营着每月10美元的付费订阅通讯，每月新增100名订阅者，却因流失损失90名；尽管注册活动看似繁忙，净增长几乎停滞，这说明真正该优先解决的是提升内容价值与留存率，而非一味加大营销投入。

businessTips.explanationEn: The price-to-earnings ratio divides a company's share price by its earnings per share, giving investors a quick way to gauge how expensive a stock is relative to the profit it actually generates. A high P/E can mean the market expects strong future growth, or it can mean a stock is simply overvalued relative to its fundamentals; a low P/E can signal a bargain or a company facing real trouble. The ratio is most useful when compared across similar companies in the same industry or against a stock's own historical average, rather than viewed in isolation.
businessTips.explanationZh: 市盈率（P/E）是用股票价格除以每股收益得出的比率，能让投资者快速判断一只股票相对于其实际盈利能力是贵还是便宜。高市盈率既可能意味着市场预期该公司未来将强劲增长，也可能只是意味着股价相对基本面被高估；低市盈率则既可能是「捡便宜」的信号，也可能反映公司正面临实际困境。该指标最有用的场合是与同行业可比公司或该股票自身历史均值进行比较，而非孤立看待。
businessTips.exampleEn: With the S&P 500 hitting record highs in August 2026 and Wall Street strategists debating stretched valuations, investors are watching the index's overall P/E ratio to judge whether the rally is backed by real earnings growth or is running ahead of company fundamentals.
businessTips.exampleZh: 随着标普500指数在2026年8月创下历史新高，华尔街策略师就估值是否过高展开争论，投资者正密切关注该指数整体市盈率，以判断这轮涨势究竟是由真实盈利增长支撑，还是已经超前于企业基本面。
